scope: Independent BTC/SOL pattern forecasts; no current strategy, PnL simulator, orders, deployment or S0 rerun.
holdout_disclosure: Historically studied price period; recipe-frozen chronological holdout, not pristine unseen market history.
origin: Each UTC whole hour t; only source bars whose end<=t. Both assets share timestamps; rows remain asset-specific.

entry.rule: Conditional on emitted signal, unconditional next-minute market reference: open of actual minute beginning t+60 seconds. No choosing a better future price. Missing data blocks the row. No gap-based cherry-picking.
entry.forecast: At t publish side, reference last closed minute close, sigma and contingent TP_j(E)=E*exp(side*sigma*q_j). Displayed reference prices are indicative. At observed entry E reanchor once deterministically, without new inference.

sigma.formula: sample std(ddof=1) of last168 completed hourly log returns * sqrt(24)

label.direction: log(last minute close ending at entry+24h / E); UP if >.25*sigma, DOWN if <-.25*sigma, else NEUTRAL
label.stop: E*exp(-side*sigma), original fixed stop, no breakeven movement
label.tp: For each side independently, conditional quantiles q=.2,.5,.8 of max(0,side*log(price/E))/sigma before original stop or expiry.
label.primary: Conservative lower MFE bound; zeros/ambiguous examples retained.
label.upper: Companion optimistic upper-bound target and heads, separately scored, never selected using CHECK.
label.stop_minute: If minute open already crosses stop, terminate at open; later extremes excluded. Otherwise lower includes prior guaranteed extrema plus minute open before stop, upper additionally includes favorable stop-minute extreme. Minute high/low ordering is unknown.
label.expiry: Use every whole minute [entry,entry+24h); terminal close from last minute ending at expiry.
label.purge: Require whole horizon through entry+24h<=partition end regardless of early stop. Apply at fit/validation/calibration/CHECK boundaries.
label.censor: Last-day incomplete forecasts reported separately, excluded from fully observed label denominators, never labelled zero.

features.warmup: Genuine minute Aug31; genuine hourly Jun-Aug; complete bins only, no synthetic upsampling.
features.representations: One shape-normalized OHLC/SMA/volume view plus causal sigma, last-price/last-panel-close, panel age and asset indicator. Numerical and image methods see same underlying bar IDs. Normalization uses window only; learned scalers fit TRAIN prefix only.

selection.metric: Mean lower-bound normalized pinball loss across both sides/three quantiles/all validation origins; tie: lower direction logloss, then smaller view/config.
selection.view_screen: Raw flattened shape+context linear/quantile control, L2=.001, evaluate all8 TF/window views on same3 TRAIN folds. Primary1h20 plus best other TRAIN-control view. This screening does not establish untested family/TF combinations are ineffective.
selection.check_rule: No CHECK labels, scores, plots or performance summaries before selected recipe/model/calibration hashes are sealed for each method. No CHECK tuning/retraining; one final evaluation per frozen method. No automatic retries after failed fit or invalid result.

stumpy.library_selection: Uniform timestamp-stratified mature TRAIN origins, independent of labels; same asset only. Exact normalized MASS-distance on selected windows, checked against installed stumpy.mass; explicitly name optimized backend.
stumpy.neighbour_independence: Greedy distance ranking with separation at least max(24h,input-window span); identical future labels cannot count as independent analogues.
stumpy.outputs: Empirical lower/upper MFE quantiles and terminal class frequencies, shrink to TRAIN prior with weight n/(n+20); no support<10 independent analogues actionable.

minirocket.head: Streaming regularized linear quantile +3-class heads; no full float64 solver/Gram matrix.

rdst.head: Same quantile/classification head; do not use RidgeClassifier fake one-hot probabilities.

cnn.architecture: Single grayscale OHLC+SMA+volume chart; three convolution stages channels8/16/32, vertical pooling, small spatial head retaining horizontal recency; plus same causal context. <=50000 parameters. No pretrained-weight claim.
cnn.final_epochs: Median best epoch across winning view inner folds, fresh fixed-epoch final fits seeds7/42; mean prediction ensemble then March calibration.

shared_head.outputs: 12 quantiles: lower/upper x long/short x3; and3 direction logits.
shared_head.loss: mean lower pinball + .5*mean upper pinball + .2*direction crossentropy; no class weights.
shared_head.linear_training: Adam lr.001 batch256 max80epochs min10 patience5; one selected best epoch per fold. Final epochs=median winning inner-fold best epoch. Weight decay=L2 candidate.
shared_head.monotonicity: Clip quantiles>=0 then ascending rearrangement within side/bound. Ties preserved; no artificial TP gaps.
shared_head.calibration: March only: additive residual quantile correction per side/bound/q, then nonnegative rearrangement; one positive temperature for direction logits constrained[.25,4]. CNN ensemble calibrated after averaging. Save uncalibrated and calibrated scores.

actionable.side: Highest direction class must be UP or DOWN and its calibrated p>=.50. No tuning this on CHECK.
actionable.levels: Primary lower-bound TP1 strictly exceeds .0011 log-distance (conservative .11% all-taker round trip relevance screen); all3 targets positive and separated by at least1e-6 log-distance. Otherwise explicit ABSTAIN; keep all-origin scores.
actionable.price_rule: Continuous prices are main forecast targets; report indicative and entry-reanchored levels. No assertion of maker execution from a candle touch; this is not exchange queue simulation.
actionable.invalidation: Original common SL, 24h expiry, or missing actual entry data; no discretionary cancel after observing outcome.

metrics: all-origin lower and upper pinball by quantile/side/asset/month
direction logloss/Brier/accuracy vs prefix prior and raw numeric control
actionable TP1/2/3 first touch before SL with lower/upper same-minute bounds and time-to-touch
signal/abstention/censor/ambiguity coverage and entry gap distribution
paired14-day block uncertainty and comparisons on same row IDs
actual example pattern catalogue, model/data/recipe hashes, resource and validation receipts

resources.profile: Measured bounded subset/one-epoch profiling before full fit; stop resource failure and report INCOMPLETE rather than declaring method ineffective. Do not change recipe based on CHECK or silently increase caps.

tests: minute path gap-stop and same-minute TP/SL ambiguity, long/short symmetry, zero MFE
next-minute entry and horizon timestamps; final24h censor and every boundary purge
feature bar_end<=origin, SMA warmup, no hourly-to-minute upsampling
TRAIN-only transform/scaler/library/calibration and immutable CHECK IDs
MASS optimized distance parity vs installedSTUMPY; correctquantileloss and noncrossing
CNN renderer deterministic/past-only; outputcontract, batchmemory profile
independent metrics/sourcehash verification on actual persisted predictions; no duplicate CHECK evaluation
